knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 4.2.10
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Which statement correctly describes what is required beyond clicking Fit for a GLM and names three output elements to interpret?
hints: Use the concept from this learning objective only.
knowledge_checks.explanation: GLM work includes coefficient interpretation, fit assessment, and diagnostics. Fit click alone or Bayesian conflation misses the requirement.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Interpret coefficients, fit measures, diagnostics; Fit alone is incomplete.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Treating Fit as finishing interpretation or conflating GLM with Bayesian modelling.

choices.label: Fit and interpret: coefficients on the link scale, fit measures such as deviance or AIC as warranted, and residual or diagnostic checks. Clicking Fit alone is incomplete without interpretation and diagnostics.
Clicking Fit finishes interpretation and diagnostics because software displays all required actuarial conclusions automatically.
Fitting a GLM finishes Bayesian credibility work because both use statistical software output.
Interpretation requires only the intercept; factor coefficients and diagnostics are optional extras.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 4.2.10
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. You fit a Poisson log-link GLM for claim counts with factor rating class. A coefficient of 0.20 on class High vs baseline is reported. Which statement is correct?
hints: Use the concept from this learning objective only.
knowledge_checks.explanation: Log-link coefficient multiplies baseline mean by exp(0.20) ≈ 1.22. Additive reading on count scale is wrong. Bayesian credibility is separate.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: exp(0.20) ≈ 1.22 times baseline mean. Refuse Fit-only and Bayesian conflation.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Additive reading of log-link coefficient or Fit-only completion.

choices.label: Under log link, β̂ = 0.20 means the fitted mean for High is e^{0.20} ≈ 1.22 times the baseline class mean (multiplicative effect), other terms held fixed. Fit without interpretation or diagnostics is incomplete; Bayesian credibility uses prior-posterior updating, not GLM log-link coefficient reading alone.
Clicking Fit finishes interpretation and diagnostics; 0.20 is read directly as a 0.20 claim count increase on the original scale.
β̂ = 0.20 means High has mean 0.20 claims because log-link coefficients are means on the count scale.
Fitting this GLM finishes Bayesian credibility premium calculation because both use Poisson counts.
